clips.title: The story
paras: Troggs hold Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine, deep beneath Gol'Bolar Quarry in eastern Dun Morogh. Ironforge dwarves once worked its tunnels for stone and rich ore, until they broke into trogg caverns and the creatures overran the site. Hammerspine leads the warband in the deepest shafts.

Ironforge dwarves once mined stone and rich ore beneath Dun Morogh's craggy peaks. Their work ended when pickaxes broke through a wall into caverns inhabited by troggs. The creatures poured from the darkness, overwhelmed the crews, and drove them from the mine. Troggs then spread across the surrounding quarry pit.

Younger, weaker troggs roam the quarry's sunlit terraces, while the mine shelters the warband's fiercest fighters. Hammerspine, their vicious chieftain, lurks deep in the cramped tunnels. Local mountaineers still need to reclaim the valuable quarry, but that means entering the mine's deepest reaches and cutting off the troggs at their source.
